# 2 Baruch Chapter 85 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 85:3 — ancestors in Sheol

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "all-our-ancestors in-time-past sinned, and-they-are-gone-into-Sheol" |
| LOGOS | "all our ancestors in time past sinned, and they are gone into Sheol" |
| PNEUMA | "all our ancestors sinned, and they have gone into Sheol" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'In time past' (Syriac: men qdim) adds the temporal marker 'formerly' which PNEUMA omits; it is part of the rhetorical contrast with 'now we ourselves' in v.4.

---

## 85:15 — tablets of the mind

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "write-it-on-the-tablets-of-your-mind" |
| LOGOS | "write it on the tablets of your mind" |
| PNEUMA | "write it on the tablets of your mind" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS/PNEUMA — full agreement. The image echoes Jeremiah 17:1 and Proverbs 3:3; all translators render it identically.
